about: Ground truths written by hand for the KV gate's allowlist (scripts/kv_truth.py --manual): rows transformers 5.12 cannot build as their config is written. 'base: transformers' builds the row's config with 'build_from' / 'build_as' / 'drop_keys' applied, and the other fields replace what that build reads; every other truth is config arithmetic, its formula in 'source'.

synth:chatglm3.source: ChatGLM3-6B arithmetic (the hub's modeling_chatglm.py): per layer a fused QKV 4096 x (4096 + 2 x 2 x 128) with bias, dense 4096 x 4096, SwiGLU 4096 x 2 x 13696 and 13696 x 4096, two norms; 65024 x 4096 embedding and output layer: 6,243,584,000 (the published count). KV: multi_query_group_num 2 x kv_channels 128 x 2

fixture:PowerInfer_SmallThinker-21BA3B-I.source: SmallThinker-21BA3B arithmetic (the hub's modeling): 52 layers of 28 x 128 queries and 4 x 128 K / V, 64 gated experts 768 wide and a 64-way router per layer, an untied 151936 x 2560 embedding and head (21.5B published); sliding_window_layout 1 marks a layer windowed at sliding_window_size 4096
